output.subject: We've received your complaint about app transfers
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about the transfers you tried to make in our mobile app. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know it is being looked at.

You told us that last night you tried to move money from your savings account to your checking account in the app. You said each attempt failed with a "something went wrong" message, four times in total. You mentioned that no money moved and that your balances looked correct afterwards. We understand how irritating it is when a routine transfer between your own accounts won't go through, especially after several tries, and we're sorry to hear how frustrating this was.

We understand you'd like to be able to move money between your accounts in the app without errors.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience, and for taking the time to let us know.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The rep's note mentions a known issue with transfers over $250 after 10pm and a fix in progress. The reply leaves this out. Decide whether to share it or a workaround.
Confirm whether the customer still needs to make this transfer urgently and whether an alternative method should be offered.
Verify that no transfers posted or are pending and that the balances are correct, as the rep noted.
The transfer amount was not recorded in the note. Check whether it is relevant to the known issue.
The reply is acknowledge-only and takes no position on the cause or the fix timing.
